title: Pooled thoracic kyphosis and ROM ranges with age trends (systematic review)
condition: asymptomatic adults, mostly standing, compiled from 45 in vivo studies

quantity.name: approximate pooled thoracic kyphosis, primary ROM and age trends
quantity.definition: review-level approximate values (abstract/discussion), not a formal meta-analysis; ROM to one side, non-radiological devices, standing

source.authors: Pan F, Firouzabadi A, Reitmaier S, Zander T, Schmidt H
source.sample: systematic review of 45 in vivo studies (n = number of studies, not subjects)

protocol.summary: Secondary compilation; use only as a plausibility envelope for thoracic inputs.
how_to_use: Check that model thoracic inputs fall near these envelopes: standing T1-T12 kyphosis ~40 deg (radiological) / ~34 deg (skin devices); one-sided ROM AR ~40, LB ~26, flexion ~21, extension ~13 deg.
For age sensitivity add ~3 deg kyphosis per decade (mainly T5-T12) and remove ~5 deg ROM per decade (sitting data, O'Gorman & Jull 1987).
Do not pool with primary-study tests (would double count their subjects).

measurement.method: review (mixed: radiograph, CT, MRI, skin markers, IMU, electromagnetic, inclinometer)

data.x: kyphosis change per decade of age
ROM change per decade of age (all planes, sitting)

extraction.uncertainty: values are 'approximately' as stated by the authors (±1 deg)
extraction.check_notes: Values re-read in abstract and Discussion (identical). Per-study tables (Tables 1-5) not extracted; primary studies are extracted separately where available.

pass_rule.rule: input data – not graded; use for robustness checks
